name: Tan Son Nhat International Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longest, 07R/25L, is 3,828 m long and 45 m wide

slots.v: Tan Son Nhat is a Level 3 coordinated airport under the CAAV decision reported on 13 Jul 2026; the page does not define Level 3 or say how non-scheduled or business flights are treated

notes: Runway, hours and coordinate quotes are AIP table cells joined with their row labels, not running text. The 2024 AIP page (effective 28 Feb 2024) could only be read up to AD 2.10; runway and noise come from the older 2023 edition (effective 30 Mar 2023) and should be re-checked against the current AIP. Runway 07R also has a displaced-threshold length of 3,059 m. Newer AIRAC editions (e.g. 19 Mar 2026) exist but could not be opened. AD 2.4 names no handling agents. Checked 2026-10-27. 1 Nov 2026: nothing added. The web page reader was refused for every official URL this run (permission not given), so no AIP page could be read. Tried: https://aim.vatm.vn/.../2024-04-18-AIRAC/html/eAIP/VV-AD-2.VVTS-en-GB.html (read on past AD 2.10). Rules above unchanged; still needs the current AD 2 pages. | 2026-11-02 run: vnaic.vn 2025-06-12 AIRAC page refused (robots_disallowed). aim.vatm.vn 2024 page ends in AD 2.10; 2023 edition AD 2.20-2.22 read: no curfew, slot or PPR text (stand 1E: no engine start-up; training flights need ATS permission). Nothing new recorded. 5 Nov 2026: added slots. The CAAV eAIP history page shows the current edition is 29 Oct 2026 and says expired issues are for information and not to be used in operations, so the 2023 and 2024 rules on file must be re-checked; AD 2 in the 19 Mar 2026 edition was refused and the 29 Oct 2026 index is a frame with no readable links. GEN 1.2 Edition 01 (30 Mar 2022, superseded) says private flights apply to CAAV at least 3 working days before departure; not recorded as a rule because newer editions exist and the current GEN 1.2 could not be read. A CAAV news item of 14 Dec 2021 says non-series slot confirmations are asked for at least 3 days ahead; not recorded, as it was read only in paraphrase and is old. CAAV's slot article of 15 Jul 2026 gives a temporary 46 flights/hour limit for 06:00 to 23:00 from 15 Jun to 6 Sep 2026; it mentions no curfew.
